test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**amongst**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about promoting peace and understanding **among all people**, indicating interaction within a group.
 
• **“Amongst”** is a preposition used to show relation within a group of people or things, and is a more formal variant of “among.”
 
• “At” refers to a point or location and is not appropriate when talking about shared values or relationships.
 
• “Of” denotes possession or origin but does not fit the context of establishing peace within a group.
 
• “Into” suggests movement or direction and is not relevant to mutual understanding and peace.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *It **makes__** no discriminations to nationality, race, religious beliefs, class or political opinions. It endeavours to **__relieve__** the suffering of individuals, being guided solely by **__their__** needs, and to give priority to the **__most__** urgent cases of distress. It promotes mutual understanding, friendship, cooperation and lasting peace **__amongst__*
